name: Hemero – Email Popups & Signup Forms
author: ninedotdev

sections.description:
Hemero is an email marketing platform for newsletters and automations. This plugin connects your WordPress site to your Hemero account in one click, with no code and no API keys to copy.

  • Signup popup on every page. Trigger, position and frequency are set on the form in Hemero.
  • Hemero form block for the block editor, plus a [hemero_form id="…"] shortcode and a classic widget for page builders and older themes.
  • WooCommerce checkout checkbox (unchecked by default): shoppers who tick “Subscribe to our newsletter” become subscribers in Hemero, in the list you choose. Works with the classic and the block checkout.
  • Your forms, lists and subscribers live in Hemero, so the same form works on your site, your other sites and your emails.

Page views never wait on Hemero: the plugin keeps a cached copy of your settings and refreshes it in the background.

Setup guide: Connect WordPress to Hemero. Questions: info@9thavenue.dev.

External service

This plugin relies on Hemero, a third-party service, to work:

  • Connecting the site sends its address, name and the WordPress admin’s return address to Hemero, after you confirm on hemero.app.
  • Your settings page and a background refresh read your forms and lists from the Hemero API.
  • Popups and forms are loaded from Hemero in your visitors’ browsers (a script for the popup, an iframe of the hosted form for inline forms). Visitors who sign up send their details to Hemero.

  • When a WooCommerce shopper ticks the newsletter checkbox, their email address, first and last name and the order number are sent to Hemero after the order is placed. Nothing is sent for shoppers who do not tick it.

  • Terms of service

  • Privacy policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Hemero and click “Connect Hemero account”. Sign in to Hemero (creating an account is free) and confirm.
  3. Pick a popup form, turn on the WooCommerce checkbox if you sell with WooCommerce, and add the “Hemero form” block to any page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Hemero account?

Yes. Signup forms, lists and emails are managed in Hemero. Creating an account is free.

Where do I design the form?

In Hemero → Forms. Changes show up on your site right away; there is nothing to update in WordPress.

Is the WooCommerce checkbox checked by default?

No. Shoppers have to tick it themselves, which is what privacy laws such as the GDPR require.

What happens when I disconnect or delete the plugin?

The popup, forms and checkbox stop showing. Contacts already added stay in your Hemero account. Deleting the plugin also revokes the site’s access in Hemero.
